title: NoCreativeAbuse
description: Protect your server from moderator Creative abuse and track suspicious item activity during survival games with friends.
body:
🛡️ # NoCreativeAbuse

Protect your server against Creative abuse and suspicious item activity with powerful tracking and moderation tools.

NoCreativeAbuse was designed for:

👑 Server owners
🧰 Administrators
👥 Groups of friends

who want a fair and transparent survival experience.

Whether you're managing a:

🌍 Public community server
🏠 Private world with friends
⚔️ Large multiplayer server

doubts can sometimes appear:

❓ "Was this item obtained legitimately?"

❓ "Did someone secretly use Creative mode?"

❓ "Did a moderator abuse their permissions?"

NoCreativeAbuse helps answer these questions through advanced tracking, logging and history systems.

---

✨ ## Features

✔ 🎮 Track all Creative mode changes

✔ 🎁 Detect items obtained directly from Creative inventory

✔ 📦 Track `/give` commands

✔ 🔍 Detect suspicious item generation

✔ 📋 Detailed player history

✔ 📊 Search and filtering system

✔ 🖥️ Optional graphical interface for players with the mod installed

✔ 🌐 Server-side compatibility — players can still join without installing the mod

✔ ⚡ Lightweight and optimized

✔ 🌍 French and English support

✔ 💾 SQLite database support

---

❓ ## Why use it?

### 👑 For server owners

🛡️ Prevent moderator or administrator abuse

👁️ Keep staff actions transparent

📈 Monitor suspicious activity

🏘️ Protect your community

---

### 👥 For survival worlds with friends

🔎 Verify if someone secretly used Creative mode

📦 Track suspicious items

🤝 Remove doubts and misunderstandings

🎮 Keep gameplay fair and enjoyable

---

NoCreativeAbuse does not aim to punish players.

Its purpose is to provide transparency and useful moderation tools while preserving a fun survival experience.

---

🤖 ## AI Development Notice

This project was designed and developed with the assistance of artificial intelligence tools.

🧠 A large part of the mod structure, systems and development workflow was assisted by AI to accelerate creation, testing and improvements.

🚀 The mod was mainly created using CreativeMode and then refined, tested and improved through multiple iterations.
